content.text: Dry, unpolluted air by volume: about 78% nitrogen, 21% oxygen, just under 1% argon, and 0.04% carbon dioxide. The figures are for dry air - water vapour varies from 0 to 4% - and the carbon dioxide share, tiny as it is, is rising steadily because of human activity. Nearly every experiment in this chapter is a way of counting that 21% of oxygen.
